ordered_diagnoses: Deep space infection of the hand

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute hand syndrome with localized infection and inflammation
salient_findings: Worsening right hand pain, swelling, and erythema
Painful, fluctuant mass in the palmar web space
Focal tenderness over the flexor sheath
key_facts: 66-year-old man with type 2 diabetes
HbA1c 11.2%
One-week history of worsening right hand pain, swelling, and erythema
Trauma to the dorsal base of the right fourth digit two weeks prior
Bruise at the site of trauma
1.5-cm painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley
Focal tenderness over the flexor sheath
Limited active digit motion
Afebrile
WBC count 17.5 × 10^9/L
Diffuse soft-tissue swelling on plain radiographs
Intact bony anatomy on plain radiographs

differentials: Deep space infection of the hand
per_call: Deep space infection of the hand

shortlist: Deep space infection of the hand

shortlist.label: Pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis
shortlist.why_kept: Painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley with focal tenderness over the flexor sheath

shortlist.label: Septic arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse soft-tissue swelling on plain radiographs and elevated WBC count

shortlist.label: Abscess
shortlist.why_kept: 1.5-cm painful, fluctuant mass and history of trauma

shortlist.label: Cellulitis
shortlist.why_kept: Erythema, swelling, and elevated WBC count

shortlist.label: Deep space infection of the hand
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse soft-tissue swelling and localized infection signs

raw.rationale: The presence of a painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley, focal tenderness over the flexor sheath, and limited active digit motion are highly suggestive of pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis, especially given the recent trauma to the area.

rejected.label: Septic arthritis
rejected.why: There is no mention of joint involvement or swelling that would suggest septic arthritis.

rejected.label: Abscess
rejected.why: While an abscess is possible, the description of the mass and the involvement of the flexor sheath and tendon suggest a more specific diagnosis of pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis.

rejected.label: Cellulitis
rejected.why: Cellulitis typically presents with more diffuse skin erythema and swelling, and the presence of a fluctuant mass and focal tenderness over the flexor sheath points towards a more localized infection like pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis.

rejected.label: Deep space infection of the hand
rejected.why: While deep space infections can present with similar symptoms, the specific involvement of the flexor sheath and tendon, as well as the location of the mass, make pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis a more precise diagnosis.
